note: Companion of lyrics.calibrated.json. Times live there only. jp: one slot per calibrated syllable, space separated. '~' = same glyph as the slot before. '_' = ghost syllable: it exists only to sync timing, it is NOT part of the lyrics, never draw it. IQ and THE END are written as printed, but their syllables are sound-alikes of the sung sound. Quotes are plain ' and " (raw files use curly ones). en: [fromSyl,toSyl(excl),text,'~'?] best effort phrases, '~' = loose split, a syllable may have no phrase. skip = raw file lines (1-based) that are not main vocal. ig = raw text not in the calibration, ignored.
